subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
3. 
Suppose the units of a product are produced at the rate of 4 units per 
useful direct labour hour. Direct labour idle time is 10% of hours paid 
for. Sales of 1,000 units are budgeted and finished goods stock is 
expected to rise by 100 units. The budgeted direct labour hours for the 
production would be: 
(a) 
306 
(b) 
250

suggested_answer: (A) 306 Total production required = Budgeted sales + Increase in finished goods stock = 1,000+100=1,100 units Production rate = 4 units per useful direct labour hour Useful hours = 1,100 units 4 units/hour = 275 hours Useful hours = 90% of paid hours: Paid hours = 275/90% = 305.55 = 306 hours
